rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a refusal or someone declining an offer.

example.english: I gave a polite declination of his invitation.
example.traditional: 我禮貌咁拒絕咗佢嘅邀請。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lai5 maau6 gam3 keoi5 zyut6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 jiu1 cing2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the angle between magnetic north and true north.

example.english: The chart clearly shows the magnetic declination at this location.
example.traditional: 航海圖清楚標示咗呢個地點嘅磁偏角。
example.jyutping: hong4 hoi2 tou4 cing1 co2 biu1 si6 zo2 ni1 go3 dei6 dim2 ge3 ci4 pin1 gok3

rows.note: Use this specifically for astronomical declination measured relative to the celestial equator.

example.english: Astronomers locate this star using its declination.
example.traditional: 天文學家根據赤緯定位呢粒星。
example.jyutping: tin1 man4 hok6 gaa1 gan1 geoi3 cek3 wai5 ding6 wai2 ne1 nap1 sing1
